name: lock-race-evidence
body:
Evidence gathered before the fix (facts verified against the branch scan; hypotheses to confirm by root-cause-before-fix).

Observed: a burst of `apg node` / `apg edge` mutations issued in parallel fails ~half the time with lbug's "Could not set lock … Resource temporarily unavailable"; the author had to re-issue strictly serially.

Three locks [fact]: (1) a purpose-built `flock` — `apg.artifacts.acquire_spec_lock` (src/artifacts.rs:25-52, "held for the life of the process") on `apg/.trans/specs.lock`; (2) lbug's own exclusive file lock on `db.lbug`; (3) git's `.git/index.lock` — every mutation commits once via `write_through_with_deletes` (src/layers.rs:2005) → `git::commit_files` (src/git.rs:587-645: `repo.index()` → `index.add_path` → `index.write()`, which create and hold the index lock). The user-visible error string is lbug's, but a DB-decoupled fix still leaves (1), (3), and the node-file read-modify-write racing; the root-cause finding and the fix must account for all three.

DB open sites [fact]: read-only at `apg.cmd_query` (src/main.rs:963, `SystemConfig::default().read_only(true)`); read-write (`SystemConfig::default()`) at `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.open` (src/artifacts.rs:240, used by `apg.artifacts.code_universes` and `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`), `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta` (src/git.rs:720), and a test path (src/main.rs:1483). DB-existence gates at src/layers.rs:1868 (code-ref validation), :2051 (staleness), :2064 (re-merge).

Lock call sites [fact]: `acquire_spec_lock` is called by the plan and review commands (src/plan_cmd.rs and src/review_cmd.rs) but NOT anywhere in src/node_cmd.rs. It also never covers the node-file read-modify-write or the git index commit.

Hypothesis A (primary): the `apg node` / `apg edge` path never acquires `specs.lock`, so its read-write DB opens (code_universes, reingest_layers, reanchor_scan_meta) escape the flock and race the same opens in OTHER concurrent processes — within one process those opens are sequential (each `ArtifactDb` drops before the next open in `validate_change` step 3, `reanchor_scan_meta`, and step 5; they do not race each other). It also never serializes the node-file read-modify-write (`edge_add`, src/node_cmd.rs:207) or the git index commit, so those race across processes too — exactly the user-visible burst.

Hypothesis B: reads escape too — `apg query` / the query tools open the DB read-only without the flock, so a read concurrent with a mutation (or two reads) can also contend.

Resolution: root-cause-before-fix must confirm which lock(s)/open(s) fail and why the flock misses them before the fix is chosen; the fix must serialize the whole sequence (node-file RMW + DB opens + git index commit), not just the DB.
